lines.direction: curt, bored authority, expecting no trouble

lines.text: I already told the constable everything I know. Now leave me be.
lines.direction: weary and wary, keeping a stranger at arm's length

lines.text: I already told the constable everything I know. Now leave me be.
lines.direction: suddenly frightened, voice dropping to a hush, glancing over the shoulder

lines.text: Everything, is it? Then you won't mind telling it again.
lines.direction: openly suspicious now, the bored act dropped — pressing and level at full voice, an unhurried edge of threat
